tools.name: matrix_add
tools.description: Add two matrices of the same dimensions entry by entry. Useful for exact matrix addition or explaining each entry step by step. Accepts integers, decimals, and fraction strings (for example 1/2); returns the exact sum matrix and a calculation for each position.

tools.name: matrix_subtract
tools.description: Subtract matrix B from matrix A when both have the same dimensions. Useful for exact matrix subtraction, including negative values and step-by-step entry calculations. Accepts integers, decimals, and fraction strings; returns each exact difference and its calculation.

tools.name: matrix_multiply
tools.description: Multiply A by B when A's column count equals B's row count, including non-square matrices. Useful for exact matrix multiplication and step-by-step row-by-column dot products. Returns exact results plus each factor pair, product, and entry calculation; accepts fractions and decimals.

tools.name: matrix_determinant
tools.description: Find the exact determinant of a square matrix using fraction-preserving elimination. Use for determinant questions requiring row swaps, elimination steps, pivot multipliers, sign changes, diagonal products, or singularity checks. Returns the determinant and detailed operation steps.

tools.name: matrix_inverse
tools.description: Find an exact inverse of a square matrix with step-by-step Gauss-Jordan elimination. Use for inverse questions needing exact fractions, augmented matrices, row swaps, normalization, elimination, and verification that A times A-inverse is identity. Returns the inverse and verification, or null with s

tools.name: matrix_transpose
tools.description: Transpose a rectangular or square matrix by exchanging rows and columns. Useful for requests to show where each result entry originated. Preserves exact integer, decimal, and fraction inputs and returns the transposed matrix with source-to-result position mappings.
